select count(distinct sr.id) FROM so_return_detail srd INNER JOIN so_return sr ON srd.main_id = sr.id AND srd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and sr.is_deleted=false
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT sr.id, sr.source_id, srd.source_detail_id, sr.create_time, sr.code, sr.source_code, sr.type, sr.approve_status, sr.invalid_status, sr.customer_id, sr.sales_org_id, sr.sales_org_name, sr.seller_id, sr.seller_name, srd.sku_id, srd.sku_no, srd.sales_qty, srd.return_qty, sr.bill_date, sr.approve_user_name, sr.create_user_name FROM so_return_detail srd INNER JOIN so_return sr ON srd.main_id = sr.id AND srd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sr.is_deleted = FALSE
AND sr.source_id = #{sourceId}

SELECT DISTINCT sr.id, sr.code AS soReturnCode, sr.source_code AS soCode, sr.seller_name, sr.warehouse_name, sr.approve_status, sr.create_time FROM so_return sr LEFT JOIN so_return_detail srd ON sr.id = srd.main_id AND sr.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE srd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sr.invalid_status = FALSE AND sr.approve_status = 'approve'
AND srd.sku_no = #{skuNo}
AND sr.code ILIKE concat('%', #{code}::text ,'%')
ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC
